text: If you're still out enjoying this evening, good news, nothing's chasing you inside. Sunset's just behind us, the air's calm at 84 with humidity way down at 40 percent, and that light south wind barely stirs the trees. Clear skies hold overnight with a low near 64, so it's a comfortable one for a porch sit or a late walk. High pressure is running the show and staying put right through tomorrow, sunny again with a high near 86 and light south winds, basically a repeat of today. The lake stays calm too, waves a foot or less tonight and just 1 to 2 feet Wednesday, water's a swimmable 75. Models are tight on this stretch, so no real hedging needed here. That said, the quiet won't last: showers and storms start working back in Thursday and Friday as a Bermuda high locks in warm, humid flow. Enjoy the dry, easy stretch while it's here, tonight's a great one to be outside past dark.
